text: Binary flag on the OP's own argument text only (source column: argument; current text including marked edits; no other columns, no reconstructing the original snapshot): 1 if the OP explicitly makes self-referential meta-commentary about platform mechanics (subreddit rules, posting/moderation, karma/votes, how the platform or delta system works, formatting/edits as platform features) or about their own status (account, newness, credentials, standing or identity on the platform), referring to themself or their post in relation to the platform/status. Generic discussion of platform/delta rules counts only if self-referential. Commentary must be explicit; quoted text from others doesn't count unless the OP adopts it. Excludes view-change/delta-award announcements, post-outcome thank-yous or resolution updates, and any text reporting whether the outcome occurred (e.g., "Edit: my view was changed", "delta awarded"), even if they contain meta-commentary. Output 0 if the argument is present with no such commentary; null if the argument is missing or malformed.
